desc: Implement median maintenance with two heaps to compute sliding window costs in O(n log x).
Compute an array `cost[i]` for all i (1-indexed) representing the minimal operations to equalize nums[i-x+1..i].
Implement DP with dimensions (k+1) x (n+1) (rolling array optimization) to find min total cost for k non-overlapping windows.
Handle edge cases: ensure windows don't overlap (DP transition only from i-x), initialize dp[0][i] = 0, others = INF.
Return `prev[n]` as the answer (optimal using prefix DP, trailing elements may be unused).
Test on the given examples and additional edge cases (k=1, small n, large x, negatives, duplicates, all equal).
Clean up the code: remove dead/commented-out helper functions and ensure the final implementation is concise and readable.
Verify time/space complexity and confirm it meets constraints (O(k·n + n log x) time, O(n) space).
